profile.headline: Software Developer at Council for Logistics Research, Inc.
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed new front-end and back-end features using Javascript, 
Jquery, datatables, Postgres, HTML/CSS, and bootstrap. 
Work through problems by writing, editing, designing, modifying, and debugging code for APIP.

positions.title: Fellow
positions.description: Fellows work in a transdisciplinary approach, being exposed to fundamental areas around software including code, content, design, quality and community. Work through problems in writing, editing, modifying, and debugging code for Elemental Selenium.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Ruby · Ruby on Rails · React.js · Node.js · Front-End Development · Selenium

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Migrated data on a backend project using SQL, JSON, Postman, Node.js to migrate customer,
historical, and current subscription orders to Kibo ecommerce from AWS.
• Created reactive web applications using React, html/CSS with the help of Figma for design.
positions.insights: Skills: Kibo Commerce · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Microservices · REST APIs · JSON · Node.js · Data Analysis · TypeScript · Oracle SQL Developer · Postman API · Representational State Transfer (REST) · Redux.js

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Design functions in JavaScript and Json that scrape the web looking for specific data to populate
SQL server.

positions.title: Student Technology Associate
positions.description: Responsibilities  include the support of internal users in the  configuration, and problem-resolution regarding PC/Network systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
During GHC 2019 I participated in their Codeathon, partnering with Code for America to revamp their home site, as well as build out their app for victims caught in hurricanes to find the nearest shelter. The site is built with Ruby on Rails, while the Hurricane Relief App is being developed with JS and Docker.

During this project I worked with the team to also discuss the challenges the site was having with their accessibility to other users considering the design.

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description: As WebDev Intern I'll be using web development tools and languages to create dynamic apps, and web pages.

positions.title: Staff
positions.description: Temp position as camp staff. Provided care similar to the care giver at the camp while guests  and their caregivers relaxed and had an extraordinary time.

volunteerExperiences.description: At Page Private School  I assisted in taking care of the students who needed help after school with projects/homework. Many times when I arrived students where in the virtual learning class room putting together their yearly projects on different continents. I also helped with their Scholastic Book Fair in getting it started, running it, and packing it back up to be sent back off.

In Expressly You Dance Organization I have helped kids who were at risk express themselves in a positive light. At Expressly you we enforced positive health activities, such as running, positive eating habits such as snacking, and focusing on education by doing homework first and foremost. Only then after will the kids express themselves through a variety of dances focused on their creativity.
